title: gpt-image-2
prompt:
Primary request: A vertical mobile infographic showing a three-layer pyramid/stack, warm cream paper background, editorial style. Bold black Chinese title: '三层评委，顺序不能反'. Three stacked layers from bottom to top:
Bottom layer (largest, sage green, solid foundation): icon of a test tube/checkmark. Label: '第一层：确定性检查'. Sub: '脚本、assert、像素 diff、帧时——你已经想到的坑。'
Middle layer (cobalt blue): icon of two screenshots side by side. Label: '第二层：截图回归'. Sub: '和上一轮的自己比，diff 飙高就是改坏了。'
Top layer (terracotta, smallest): icon of a fresh eye / magnifying glass. Label: '第三层：新鲜眼睛的 LLM 评委'. Sub: '只管审美和语义，可以驳回——它不是裁判，是品味顾问。'
A big red arrow on the side pointing UP labeled '门槛 → 建议'. At bottom a warning box: '只让 LLM 当裁判 = 灾难。它会让你一路冲到局部最优。'
Clean flat illustration, readable Chinese PingFang/Source Han Sans, gold accents, generous whitespace, no watermark.
